quality_assessment: Chapter provides good coverage of output formatting options but contains one significant error about --pretty flag and misses some available features. Most content is accurate and well-organized.

issues.description: Chapter incorrectly describes --pretty/-p as pretty-printing JSON output
issues.current_content:
# Pretty-printed JSON (using -p or --pretty)
rg --json -p pattern
rg --pretty pattern
issues.should_be: --pretty is a convenience alias for --color=always --heading --line-number, NOT for pretty JSON
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the misleading JSON pretty-print example at lines 43-45. If discussing --pretty, explain it's for human-readable colored output (--color=always --heading --line-number), not JSON formatting. JSON output is always in JSON Lines format.

issues.description: Chapter mentions 'default' format and custom format but doesn't list all 5 available hyperlink formats
issues.current_content:
# Enable hyperlinks with default format
rg --hyperlink-format default pattern

# Custom hyperlink format
rg --hyperlink-format file://{path} pattern
issues.should_be: Document all available formats: default, file, grep, kitty, vscode
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a list of available hyperlink formats after line 161: 'Available formats: default, file, grep, kitty, vscode. Each format is optimized for different terminal emulators or tools.'

issues.description: Chapter doesn't mention 'auto' buffering mode which is the default
issues.current_content:
# Line-buffered output (flush after each line)
rg --line-buffered pattern

# Block-buffered output (default)
rg --block-buffered pattern
issues.should_be: Document auto mode as the default that automatically chooses based on whether output is a tty
issues.fix_suggestion: Update line 146 to clarify that auto-detection is the actual default, and block buffering is used when not connected to a tty. Add explanation that auto mode intelligently selects line vs block buffering.

issues.description: Chapter doesn't document --path-separator option for customizing path separators
issues.should_add: Document --path-separator for custom path separators in output
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection under 'Additional Output Options' for path separator customization, similar to field separators section.

issues.description: Chapter doesn't document --stats flag for showing search statistics
issues.should_add: Document --stats for displaying search statistics including files searched, matches found, and time elapsed
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection about statistics output mode with --stats flag. This is useful for performance analysis and understanding search scope.

issues.description: Chapter mentions 'ansi' as a color option but this isn't clearly documented in implementation
issues.current_content: rg --color ansi pattern    # Use ANSI colors only
issues.should_verify: Verify if 'ansi' is a valid --color option or if this should be removed
issues.fix_suggestion: Check if 'ansi' is a valid color choice. If not, remove line 69. The standard options are: auto, always, never.

positive_aspects: Comprehensive coverage of major output formatting options
Clear examples for each feature with practical bash commands
Good organization with logical grouping of related features
Helpful JSON output structure explanation with message types
Excellent color customization documentation with specific color types and attributes
Practical examples section showing real-world usage patterns
Best practices section provides valuable guidance
improvement_suggestions: Verify and correct the --pretty flag documentation (critical)
Add all available hyperlink format options
Add --stats flag documentation for performance analysis
Consider adding a troubleshooting section for common output formatting issues
Add examples of combining multiple formatting options
Consider adding a comparison table of different output modes (standard, JSON, vimgrep, etc.)

metadata.validation_focus: Check that JSON output, color specs, field separators, and all output formatting options are documented
